image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab served on a white plate. The crab is bright orange-red, indicating it has been boiled or steamed. The carapace is broad and oval. Several legs and large claws are visible, tucked around the body. In the foreground, out of focus, is another portion of a crab or crab leg. The background features a blurred blue surface, possibly a tablecloth or wall.
